assessment: This important study by Lu et al aimed to determine the key factors of T cell responses associated with durable antibody responses following the initial two shots of COVID-19 mRNA vaccinations. By comparing the SARS-CoV-2 spike protein (S)-specific T cell subsets between ‘Ab sustainers’ and ‘Ab decliners’ that were present post-vaccination, the authors concluded that S-specific CD4+ T cells in ‘Ab sustainers’ were enriched with Tfh cells. There is solid evidence as the authors applied multiple methods and approaches to address the key questions, and the presented data are robust.
